deviations_from_card: (1) Case 2 (role completeness) as written fails on the base tree for a reason other than colour: five geometry custom properties (--ln-zoom-x/y, --ln-row-centre, --ln-flag-size, --ln-lane-room) are declared by their own rules, not the token block, and moving them is outside the card. The test is 'every --ln-* referenced is declared somewhere in the sheet, and every --ln-* that carries a colour is declared in the token block'. It passes on the base tree (nothing references a role yet), so it was proven by mutation instead: a typo'd var(--ln-ink-hel) and a pasted rgb(4 7 8 / 84%) both turned it and the ban red, and the ban named var(--ln-scrim). (2) Guard 7 (role value == old literal) is a pinned table of the 28 replaced values. It is red before because the roles did not exist, so 6 of 8 cases were red before (1-5 minus 2, plus 7); guards 5 and 6 (the existing tests) were green before and after, unchanged. (3) One extra pixel move: the new contrast gate found .ln-figure[data-lead=true] span at opacity 0.85 = 3.88:1 (good) and 4.38:1 (alert) on the card's --ln-raise ground. The 0.85 is dropped in l2-the-card.css (in the write set) and named in the commit and ADR. (4) A one-glyph pseudo-element separator (.ln-crumb-up::after '/', --ln-rule) is exempted from the text contrast check as punctuation, and the test says so. (5) Added ADR 0169 (the brief's one-decision-one-ADR rule) and a single commit rather than the card's three.
